dashboards.title: Bugzila Dashboard V3.P3.006
dashboards.summary: A compact three-page motorsport dashboard focused on adaptive shift guidance, pedal telemetry and lap analysis.
dashboards.concept: Keep the most important driving information readable at a glance on the KS Pro display while dedicating separate pages to pedal technique and lap performance.
dashboards.previewNote: Preview screenshots are from V3.P3.004. V3.P3.006 keeps the same dashboard layout and telemetry behavior with the updated flat dark gray #1C1F24 background theme.

pages.name: Page 1 — Drive / Adaptive Shift
pages.description: Vehicle speed, current gear, engine RPM and adaptive shift guidance.

pages.name: Page 2 — Native Pedal Chart
pages.description: Continuous throttle and brake traces using two native Chart.qml components with live percentages.

pages.name: Page 3 — Lap Analysis
pages.description: Current, previous, best and average lap analysis with average-speed comparison.

dashboards.title: Bugzila Dashboard V1.P3.010
dashboards.summary: A three-page race-engineer style dashboard focused on track awareness, tyre condition, race timing, fuel strategy and fast-access car setup.
dashboards.concept: Split race information into three focused screens: track and race awareness, tyre and timing management, then fuel strategy and core car setup values for quick decisions while driving.
dashboards.previewNote: Screenshots are from the current V1.P3.010 dashboard package supplied for MOZA KS Pro.
features: TC / ABS / Brake Bias / Engine Map

pages.name: Page 1 — GPS Map + Race Status
pages.description: 2D GPS track map with player/opponent markers, race status, position, lap, fuel laps, pit information and live-event status.

pages.name: Page 2 — Tyre State + Race Time
pages.description: Top-view tyre state with pressure, temperature and condition, plus current, last and best lap timing with position and lap.

pages.name: Page 3 — Fuel Strategy + Car Setup
pages.description: Fuel laps, remaining fuel and consumption per lap together with quick-access TC, ABS, brake bias and engine map values.

dashboards.title: Bugzila CM2 V3Practice.P3.021
dashboards.summary: P3.021 replaces unreliable tyre-life data with a new color-coded Balance Graph, improves TYRE COACH readability, fixes ACC Fuel/Lap using a verified fallback calculation, and preserves the existing Delta, Dual Map, Pedal Training, and GT3 driver coaching features.
dashboards.concept: Built for beginner and intermediate sim racers who want to learn the track, improve pedal technique, understand tyre and brake behavior, and become more familiar with GT3 car controls. Page 1 answers “Where am I on the track?”, Page 2 answers “What am I doing with the pedals?”, and Page 3 answers “Are the tyres and brakes ready, and what is the car doing?”. P3.021 improves PAGE 3 — TYRES & BRAKES with clearer live telemetry presentation, a new color-coded Balance Graph, updated Readiness + Balance coaching, and a verified ACC Fuel/Lap fallback while preserving the existing Dual Map, Pedal Training and Delta behavior.
dashboards.previewNote: Page 1 and Page 2 preview screenshots remain real-device photos from Bugzila_CM2_V3Practice.P3.017. Page 3 preview is updated to a real-device P3.021 screenshot showing the new Readiness + Balance layout, Balance Graph, and Fuel/Lap fix. Current release is V3Practice.P3.021 — Bug Fix Update / CM2 Hardware Verified.

pages.name: Page 1 — Track View
pages.description: Dual-map practice page with a large rotating Driver Map, a smaller Full Track overview, live driver telemetry, session status and lower track information for circuit familiarization.

pages.name: Page 2 — Pedal Input
pages.description: Driver-input training page with a large throttle / brake history graph, live pedal bars, coaching reminder and shared speed, gear, RPM and control information.

pages.name: Page 3 — Tyres & Brakes
pages.description: Tyre-management and brake-management page with four-wheel status, car controls, fuel, live delta, Tyre Coach readiness, the new color-coded Balance Graph, and environment data.
